needs_ledger.plain: Davos DCPD-202600046, Air Force One DCPD-202600051, the January 21 Truth Social post, NATO Arctic Sentry, Danish Defence January 15, and AP July 7 are saved. The Monday map post is saved with no accompanying text.
The 2015 joint declaration and Council Decision (EU) 2021/1764 (€225 million) are saved.
Nielsen, Frederiksen, von der Leyen, and Síkela are on the saved records. The White House statements listing and State press-releases listing saved September 8 do not name the Commission package.
The press release and factsheet name a total and projects. No table splits the €200 million by project, year, or budget line.

Reuters €200 million ($232 million) checks out. KNR 150 million is a labeled provisional figure. ABC claims and DW/Al Jazeera annex point at the January Davos record.
